description: This file is a shell script used for testing the behavior of Git submodule merge scenarios, including setup of test repositories, various merge conflicts, and conflict resolution workflows.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a successful test case with a descriptive string and a command sequence.

methods.name: test_when_finished
methods.description: Registers cleanup commands to run after the test.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that a command should fail.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or outputs.

methods.name: test_path_is_dir
methods.description: Checks if a specified path is a directory.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks if a specified path is missing.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Verifies the number of lines in a file.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within files.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified content.
